name: HANSA-PARK Resort am Meer
description: HANSA-PARK Resort am Meer is a holiday park of holiday homes at Am Fahrenkrog 91 in Sierksdorf, right next to Hansa-Park (a railway line lies between the two). It is the closest place to stay and a practical base for families, with self-catering homes for groups of different sizes.

rooms.name: Holiday Home (up to 4)
rooms.description: Self-catering holiday home for small families.

rooms.name: Holiday Home (up to 6)
rooms.description: Larger self-catering holiday home for groups.

name: Hof Sierksdorf
description: Hof Sierksdorf is a 3-star hotel at Am Strande 32 in Sierksdorf, about 2.25 km from Hansa-Park. Rates found online were around €114 a night, a simple, comfortable choice close to the park.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Room with extra beds for families.

name: Arborea Marina Resort Neustadt
description: Arborea Marina Resort Neustadt is a marina resort in Neustadt in Holstein, about 2.3 km from Hansa-Park. Rates found online were roughly €121 to €130 a night, a good option for guests who want a waterfront stay.

rooms.name: Double Room
rooms.description: Comfortable double room at the marina.

name: Hotel Meerzeit
description: Hotel Meerzeit is a small 40-room hotel in Scharbeutz, about 3 km from Hansa-Park. Rates found online were around $77 (roughly €70) a night, making it one of the cheaper choices near the park.

rooms.name: Double Room
rooms.description: Simple double room close to the beach.

name: ATLANTIC Grand Hotel Travemünde
description: ATLANTIC Grand Hotel Travemünde is a seafront hotel in Lübeck-Travemünde, about 14 km from Hansa-Park. Rates found online were around $145 (roughly €135) a night, the most upscale choice of the five.

rooms.name: Sea View Room
rooms.description: Room with a view of the Baltic Sea.
